title: Diviner
description: A Slay the Spire 2 character mod built around Destiny, Divination, Foretell, Doom, and Revelation.
changeNote:
Rest-site stability hotfix candidate:
- Generated combat cards are now created and placed atomically, preventing unplaced cards from surviving a failed pile operation.
- Rewrite the Sign now transforms all eligible cards in one operation.
- Marked Deck now modifies each reward only during the late reward pass and no longer retains old reward lists.
- Added persistent diagnostics for combat cleanup, rest-site option generation, and rest-site room setup.
